name: the laptop lid falls shut and sends it to sleep
looks: The same laptop's lid swings down and settles shut under a headline saying it falls asleep, small hand-drawn "Z" marks drifting up from the hinge to sell the idea of the device dozing off.
build: squash-stretch-ball-demo's physical-honesty approach applied to the hinge: the lid rotates closed on a real eased fall (power2.in then a soft settle bounce), with two or three outline "Z" glyphs easing upward and fading as they rise.
sound: A soft mechanical close, a gentle chime as the Zs drift up.
prompt: Animate a device's lid or cover swinging shut and settling with a small honest bounce, under a headline about it going to sleep. Let a couple of small drifting glyphs (sleep marks, a dimming dot) rise and fade near the hinge to sell the idea without any text label needed.
